t: THE MYSTERIES OF THE LIFE OF CHRIST OUR LORD › OF THE MYSTERIES FROM THE CROSS TO THE SEPULCHRE, INCLUSIVE

items.e: First Point. First: He was let down from the Cross by Joseph and Nicodemus, in presence of His sorrowful Mother.
Second Point. Second: The Body was carried to the Sepulchre and anointed and buried.
Third Point. Third: Guards were set.
